name: Mahjong for a Cause
description: Official event page (Mahjong 101): "In this hands-on class, you'll learn the fundamentals of American Mahjong in a fun, relaxed, and encouraging environment." Also covers how to read the National Mahjong League card; leagues play the 2026 NMJL Card. Open Play and Mahjong 101 are open to the public (no membership required; optional monthly pass). Held at Hall's Hall, Friendswood.
schedule: Open Play Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat/Mon sessions weekly ($10-$15); Mahjong 101 Wednesdays; Monthly Pass $75
